top_signals.title: China Revives Free-Trade Zone Bond Market After 2023 Crackdown
top_signals.summary: Signs of life are returning to the Shanghai free-trade zone’s bond market, which went quiet in late 2023 after Chinese authorities clamped down on excessive borrowing by local governments.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
